title: feat(oracle): add stable review workflow
body:
## Change Summary

- Promote the Oracle review workflow to `skills-stable/oracle`.
- Add a bundled repo-zip helper and context manifest template for browser-based Oracle runs.
- Refresh skillshare metadata, `.gitignore`, and `.skillignore` so the stable Oracle skill and ignored skill groups sync as intended.

## Related

- Linear: not linked
- Threads:
  - https://ampcode.com/threads/T-019e824d-760b-700b-997f-8684b0bf3be5
  - https://ampcode.com/threads/T-019e822c-b729-74ea-af6a-a9ff8823e310

## Verification

- `skillshare sync --json`
- commit hooks: end-of-file fixer, trailing whitespace, AST check, merge-conflict check, shebang executable check, large-file check, private-key detection, Ruff, ripsecrets
- push hooks: AST check, merge-conflict check, large-file check, symlink checks, private-key detection, Biome, markdownlint-cli2, ripsecrets, typos, autocorrect, ty, ls-lint
- `git diff --cached --check`
- confirmed PR diff contains no `skills-beta/` paths
